name: open-science-skills
tagline_zh: 写实验方案总怕漏步骤？这套技能直接照搬顶刊方法学，连文本分析和稿件自查都备好，让审稿人挑不出刺。
tagline_en: Stop reinventing methods. Steal from published social-science protocols—design, text-mine, QA your manuscript.
desc_en: Agentic skills for Claude Code and Codex, built from published social-science methods sources. Covers experimental design, computational text analysis, manuscript QA, and transparent reporting.
why_zh: 同类工具多讲理论，它直接内置已发表论文的方法流程，照做即合规，省去翻文献的功夫。
why_en: Unlike generic advice, it encodes real published methods into executable steps—so your design and reporting match journal.
